name: Safe landing spot A (Jan window)
note: Derived by us, not a named site. Checked in Find sites for a 14-day mission (sunlit >= 60%, darkness <= 48 h, Earth >= 50%), slope <= 8 deg, 4 km landing circle, 21 points computed exactly.
